newsitem.title: KUWAIT: KNPC to build 300,000 tn/yr calcinated coke plant.
newsitem.headline: KNPC to build 300,000 tn/yr calcinated coke plant.

text.p: Kuwait's state oil refiner, Kuwait National Petroleum Co (KNPC), plans to build a calcinated petroleum coke plant with an annual capacity of 300,000 tonnes, the official Kuwait News Agecy reported on Wednesday.
"KNPC announced today that the establishment of a calcinated petroleum coke plant has been approved," the agency said.
KNPC plans to build the plant at its Mina Abdulla refinery whose capacity stands at about 250,000 barrels per day (bpd), it said without giving further details. about the project.
The product would be used in aluminium smelters mainly in the Gulf region, it added.
